description: Archive a card (Planka's hidden archive column) or bring it back with restoreToListId. Archiving hides the card from the board without deleting it; verified by re-reading its column.

position.description: Position in the column when restoring. Defaults to the end.

restoreToListId.description: Un-archive instead: move the card into this column. The card's previous column is reported when archiving.

name: planka_archive_card
title: Archive or restore card
